answer: Pay only for work that survives daylight. Each job leaves a receipt, a relic tied to that worker's history, maturing only after a three-epoch contest window: anyone may challenge it with evidence, and a winning challenge voids it and re-opens the worker's other receipts. Earnings unlock solely from matured receipts, so a hollow identity earns nothing however many accounts its operator spins up. A winning challenger takes a sparrow bounty. One earning fake needs twenty matured receipts, each a real job, so a hundred fakes cost a hundred times that work.
